name: The Bioluminescent Bird Market
description: A night market in an enchanted forest where birds made of glowing feathers perch on stalls, selling radiant feathers, songs, and starlight.
prompt: A vibrant Bioluminescent Bird Market: birds with iridescent glowing feathers perched on wooden stalls, vendors offering radiant plumage and singing melodies, firefly lights hanging above, dense forest backdrop, dynamic composition, fantasy night scene.
caption: Trade in songs and starlight at the Bioluminescent Bird Market—where every feather shines with its own story 🐦✨.
